Background

Survey data limited to Q1 (Jan-Mar) and Q3 (Jul-Sep) for best comparison among sites. Surveys are divided by “Fixed” and “Random” for comparisons.
Fixed = planned repeated sampling stations
Random = single sampling event or station that is selected randomly for survey and has the potential for re-sampling if same station is selected across time
Data is assessed at the quadrat level for comparisons.

Model post-hoc


Model post-hoc:
Q: When accounting for the zero-inflation process, how does expected oyster abundance vary among Estuaries and Quarters? (Live ~ Estuary * Quarter + Year) > Estimated marginal mean live oyster abundance by estuary and quarter, with Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons.
Q: How does the probability of an additional/structural zero vary among Estuaries and Quarters? (ziformula = ~ Estuary + Quarter) > Estimated probability of a structural zero by estuary and quarter, with Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons.
Is live abundance different among estuaries?
